how: Reviewer-recorded on DGX Spark (Linux aarch64) as the dedicated test user zylos-test with a temporary HOME, @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.327 in a temporary npm prefix, authenticated through the relay (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN in the environment, removed afterwards), onboarding, trust and bypass acceptance pre-seeded in ~/.claude.json. Launched with --dangerously-skip-permissions in a private tmux socket, pane 200x50; no message was sent to the model. Each screen is unmodified `tmux capture-pane -p` output; cursorX/cursorY are `display -p '#{cursor_x}'` / `'#{cursor_y}'` read immediately before the capture and re-read unchanged immediately after it.
